newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Siberian railway blocked by striking miners.
newsitem.headline: Siberian railway blocked by striking miners.

text.p: Striking Russian coalminers blocked the Trans-Siberian railway on Wednesday, holding up 17 passenger trains, Itar-Tass news agency said.
Hundreds of miners, demanding payment of up to eight months of back wages, blocked the line at Anzhero-Sudzhensk, north of the Kuzbass mining capital Kemerovo in southern Siberia.

First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais, who visited the distressed Kuzbass last month, was quoted by Interfax news agency as saying he had instructed the finance ministry on Tuesday to dispatch 20 billion roubles ($3.5 million) to Anzhero-Sudzhensk to begin paying off wage and welfare arrears.

Though air travel has cut the trip to Siberia and Russia's far eastern provinces to a matter of hours, the cost means that many people, particularly heavily laden small traders, still prefer to journey for days on end by the Trans-Siberian railway.
